sourceLimits: The currently selected individual V2 original-project portrait is internal authority, not external franchise proof.
Only visible surfaces qualify. Hidden reverse construction, exact microdetails and tiny shield paint marks remain uncertain; no absolute 1:1 certification.
Chronological age is unknown; all variants remain fully clothed, family-safe and without romance.
New compositions use the actual Nine Realms: Last Twilight manifest, without claiming historical Norse accuracy.
Previous atlas personally opened: old short blue outfit and unarmed poses differ from the source; it is preserved as historical only.
